item.title: Filipino Families Seek Justice Ahead of ICC Proceedings for Duterte
item.description: Relatives of deceased Filipinos are pursuing accountability as former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte prepares to face the International Criminal Court. The former leader is accused of crimes against humanity, which involve eighty-five homicides.

item.title: Severe US Thanksgiving storms cause widespread flooding and flight delays
